slides.headline: Anthropic gives auditors deep access
slides.body: Six METR researchers will use Anthropic hardware and office space to review models.

slides.headline: Access matches internal risk teams
slides.body: Auditors can use internal tools and systems similar to Anthropic’s own risk assessment staff.

slides.headline: METR will publish findings
slides.body: All results will be released; Anthropic can only withhold sensitive data.

slides.headline: Why it matters
slides.body: External audits may help identify safety risks, but some information remains hidden.

slides.headline: Share your thoughts
slides.body: Do you trust external audits to keep AI safe?
